APPROVER_NAME.expr: pick(['Victoria Hale','Marcus Reid','Priya Mehta','Daniel Okafor','Sofia Rossi','Kenji Sato','Hannah Clarke','Omar Haddad','Elena Novak','Liam Walker','Grace Taylor','Arjun Singh'])

columns.name: MCC_GROUP
columns.expr: {'Airfare':'Airlines','Lodging':'Hotels & Lodging','Meals & Entertainment':'Restaurants & Bars','Ground Transport':'Transportation','Mileage':'Personal Vehicle','Per Diem':'Per Diem Allowance','Conferences & Training':'Events & Education','Software & Subscriptions':'Digital Services','Office Supplies':'Retail','Client Gifts':'Retail'}[r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']]

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.expr: weighted({'Travel Agency (TMC)':62,'Corporate Card':33,'Out-of-Pocket':5}) if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']=='Airfare' else 'Out-of-Pocket' if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY'] in ('Mileage','Per Diem') else weighted({'P-Card':65,'Corporate Card':35}) if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY'] in ('Software & Subscriptions','Office Supplies') else weighted({'Corporate Card':62,'Out-of-Pocket':38})

columns.name: PROJECT_CLIENT
columns.expr: pick(['Northwind Logistics','Bluepeak Health','Harborline Bank','Cobalt Retail Group','Vantage Insurance','Summit Ridge University','Ironclad Manufacturing','Lumen Media','Meridian Airlines','Clearwater Pharma','Atlas Freight','Keystone Capital']) if r['DEPARTMENT'] in ('Sales','Customer Success','Professional Services','Executive') and chance(0.6) else 'Internal'

columns.name: EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD
columns.expr: r['NEGOTIATED_RATE_USD'] * lognorm(1.02 + (0.24 * ramp(270) if r['CITY'] in ('New York','London') else 0), 0.10) if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']=='Lodging' else lognorm({'Airfare':450,'Meals & Entertainment':38,'Ground Transport':32,'Mileage':34,'Per Diem':80,'Conferences & Training':950,'Software & Subscriptions':40,'Office Supplies':65,'Client Gifts':110}[r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']], 0.55)

columns.name: POLICY_FLAG
columns.expr: ('Over Hotel Cap' if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']=='Lodging' and r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] > r['NEGOTIATED_RATE_USD']*1.1 else 'Alcohol on Receipt' if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']=='Meals & Entertainment' and chance(0.05 * (1 + 1.3*ramp(180) if r['DEPARTMENT']=='Sales' else 1)) else 'Over Meal Limit' if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY']=='Meals & Entertainment' and r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] > 75 and chance(0.6 * (1 + 1.3*ramp(180) if r['DEPARTMENT']=='Sales' else 1)) else 'Missing Receipt' if r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] > 75 and chance(0.04) else 'Duplicate Suspected' if chance(0.006) else 'Weekend Expense' if dow >= 5 and chance(0.4) else 'None')

columns.name: POLICY_STATUS
columns.expr: {'None':'In Policy','Missing Receipt':'Missing Receipt','Alcohol on Receipt':'Hard Violation','Duplicate Suspected':'Hard Violation'}.get(r['POLICY_FLAG'], 'Soft Violation')

columns.name: OUT_OF_POLICY_AMOUNT_USD
columns.expr: 0.0 if r['POLICY_FLAG']=='None' else r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] - r['NEGOTIATED_RATE_USD']*1.1 if r['POLICY_FLAG']=='Over Hotel Cap' else r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] - 75 if r['POLICY_FLAG']=='Over Meal Limit' else r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] * uniform(0.2, 0.45) if r['POLICY_FLAG']=='Alcohol on Receipt' else r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD']

columns.name: AUDIT_RISK_SCORE
columns.expr: int(max(1, min(99, round(rng.betavariate(1.8, 12)*100 + {'In Policy':0,'Soft Violation':18,'Hard Violation':38,'Missing Receipt':26}[r['POLICY_STATUS']] + (7 if r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] > 1000 else 0)))))

columns.name: VAT_RECLAIMABLE_USD
columns.expr: r['EXPENSE_AMOUNT_USD'] * {'United Kingdom':0.2,'Germany':0.19,'France':0.2,'Netherlands':0.21,'Australia':0.1,'Singapore':0.09,'Japan':0.1,'Canada':0.05}.get(r['COUNTRY'],0) / 1.2 * uniform(0.7, 1.0) if r['EXPENSE_CATEGORY'] in ('Lodging','Meals & Entertainment','Ground Transport','Conferences & Training','Office Supplies') else 0.0

post.name: APPROVAL_DAYS
post.expr: None if r['REPORT_STATUS'] in ('Draft','Pending Approval','Returned') else round(lognorm(2.1, 0.65) * (1.6 if r['SUBMITTED_DATE'] and r['SUBMITTED_DATE'].month in (3,6,9,12) and r['SUBMITTED_DATE'].day >= 20 else 1), 1)

post.name: REIMBURSEMENT_DAYS
post.expr: rng.randint(2, 14) if r['REPORT_STATUS']=='Reimbursed' and r['PAYMENT_METHOD']=='Out-of-Pocket' else None

post.name: DAYS_PENDING
post.expr: age if r['REPORT_STATUS']=='Pending Approval' else None
